record.title: Manufacturing schedule throughput current
record.body: Exact same-run attribution binds 108 semantic marketplace commits across R75 PR #304 and R76 PR #309 using Schedule-Run/Schedule-Cell trailers. Merge commits are tracked separately: e11e19ba and 04cd8add. First exact attributed commit was 2026-08-26T02:14:15Z; R76 merge completed 2026-08-26T02:47:14Z, yielding ~196.46 semantic commits/hour over elapsed manufacturing interval. Two exact commit-active windows total ~17.98 minutes, yielding ~360.33 commits/active-hour. Previous-hour, previous-same-cell and 24h mean remain UNKNOWN because no exact canonical comparable PRE rates were admitted; R76 now instruments those gaps instead of fabricating deltas.
